sources.title: Retrieval Interruption Framework: AI-Assisted Cognition and ... - MDPI
sources.snippet: This conceptual paper develops the Retrieval Interruption Framework (RIF) through a targeted narrative synthesis of research on retrieval practice, productive failure, scaffolding, cognitive load, cognitive offloading, metacognitive monitoring, the expertise reversal effect, the assistance dilemma, and AI-assisted learning.
